answer.reason: The only thing the verses tell of Zebedee himself is that his sons left him in the ship to follow Jesus; the rest concerns his sons or his wife.

clauses.english: was left in the ship by his sons when Jesus called them
clauses.quote: they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants

doubts: Most marked verses (MAT 10:2, MAT 20:20, MAT 26:37, MAT 27:56, MRK 3:17, MRK 10:35, LUK 5:10, JHN 21:2) only name him as the father of James and John, or tell what his sons or his wife did, so they are not used.
